flashcards.back: Define standard units, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define accurate measurement, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define distance, give an example, and explain why it matters.
Define motion, give an example, and explain why it matters.

interactive_activities.title: Explore standard units
interactive_activities.instructions: Use a safe, age-appropriate task specifically focused on standard units. Record what you notice, explain it, and state what you learned.

interactive_activities.title: Use it in a new situation
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where accurate measurement is useful and explain your reasoning.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach motion to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps.
